scan_linter_check.description:
Flags string literals containing email addresses, in any script. Addresses in scripts differ between environments (test instances should not mail real people) and change without a code release. Addresses at example.com/.org/.net are ignored.
Replaces the email part of the legacy check "NS: Hardcoded sys_ids, Emails, or Group Names".
scan_linter_check.name: SN-CFG-003: Hardcoded email address
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Send to users or groups, or read addresses from a system property or a notification recipient list, so they can differ per environment and change without a code change.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A string literal in a script contains an email address.
